id: \bI don't think I'm moving from this spot anytime soon.
en: \bI don't think I'm moving from this spot anytime soon.
it: \bNon credo che mi sposterò da qui tanto presto.

id: \rI can teach your Pokémon a move.
en: \rI can teach your Pokémon a move.
it: \rPosso insegnare una mossa ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bEveryone is ready to go except for Lillie. As soon as you find her we can leave.
en: \bEveryone is ready to go except for Lillie. As soon as you find her we can leave.
it: \bSono tutti pronti a partire tranne Lylia. Appena la trovi possiamo andare.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?

id: \bDid you see the girl with the Vulpix?
en: \bDid you see the girl with the Vulpix?
it: \bHai visto la ragazza con il Vulpix?

id: \rI landed far. I hope my jump was good enough.
en: \rI landed far. I hope my jump was good enough.
it: \rSono atterrata lontano. Spero che il mio salto sia stato abbastanza buono.

id: \rLillie: Is it already time to go? I'm sorry I got distracted teaching Snowy. Let me show you.
en: \rLillie: Is it already time to go? I'm sorry I got distracted teaching Snowy. Let me show you.
it: \rLylia: È già ora di andare? Scusa, mi sono distratta ad allenare Snowy. Lascia che te lo mostri.

id: \rLillie: Right, we need to go. Sorry I'll head back right now.
en: \rLillie: Right, we need to go. Sorry I'll head back right now.
it: \rLylia: Giusto, dobbiamo andare. Scusa, torno subito indietro.
\rHo bisogno di qualcosa che mi distragga.

id: \bMy fighting spirit will push me on!
en: \bMy fighting spirit will push me on!
it: \bIl mio spirito combattivo mi spingerà avanti!

id: \bI can't even see in this snow.
en: \bI can't even see in this snow.
it: \bCon questa neve non riesco nemmeno a vedere.

id: \bJust a hiker, no need to worry about me.
en: \bJust a hiker, no need to worry about me.
it: \bSono solo un escursionista, non preoccuparti per me.
